note: Release run on commit 104e57d (build digest 94a512df50bb9d43, equal to the release build 2.9.1+94a512df50bb9d43; that commit changed only release documents, which are not build inputs). One dispatch with release_tag=v2.9.1: the package job built the Linux x64 package, checked it with sha256sum --check and the packaged smoke test, and only then attached it to the draft GitHub Release v2.9.1 with --clobber, replacing the stale 2.9.0 package the draft held before. The release stays a draft and no tag was created. The package was downloaded with gh release download, checked by scripts/linux-release-assets.mjs (checksum file and version) and sha256sum --check; its PACKAGE_MANIFEST.json records build 2.9.1+94a512df50bb9d43, platform linux-x64 and rules website/2.9.1.
